records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our software and products revenue was 45% of our total revenues for both the nine months ended December 31, 2021 and 2020, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Larger deals (transactions greater than $0.1 million) represented 71% and 69% of our total software and products revenue in the nine months ended December 31, 2021 and 2020, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Software and products revenue generated through indirect distribution channels accounted for approximately 90% of total software and products revenue in both the nine months ended December 31, 2021 and 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To the extent the U.S. dollar weakens against foreign currencies, the translation of these foreign currency denominated transactions generally results in increased revenue, operating expenses and income from operations for our non-U.S. operations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: – Net cash provided by operating activities was impacted by net income adjusted for the impact of non-cash charges, an increase in accounts receivable and deferred commissions and a decrease in accrued liabilities.
